subject: GTA VI on the Windows D3D12 runtime integration

observations.result: The maintainer reports that the Rockstar Games Presents title card now appears.
The reported load reaches the first mission’s intro. The picture stays black and the host GPU fails within seconds. The cause is unresolved.

hardwareForThisRun.scope: Machine identified by the maintainer for the five-stage report.

limitations: The five-stage count describes the scope of this report. PortWatch assigns its own milestones.

shaderCompilerInvestigation20261125.offlineResult: Both still access-violate below 0.6 GiB job commit. New native reports identify amdxc64.dll+0x861b9f reading address0x8.

shaderCompilerInvestigation20261125.status: Compatible descriptor binding workaround under investigation; no gameplay fix claimed.

interpretation: Every run stopped at the unchanged physical-memory reserve; none completed the requested four minutes.
Many intro/loading interval samples reached 30 FPS, but severe loading dips remain.
The shorter texture-retention policy did not resolve world-entry memory pressure.
The nonblocking-read run reduced the worst sampled texture preparation from 273.5 to 12.5 ms, but used one compiler worker; this is not isolated causal attribution.
Timed counters overlap and must not be summed. made_* fields are cumulative, null pool values mean unavailable.
No matching device-removal log or Windows event is not proof of driver health.
Captured non-silent PCM does not establish audible speaker output, correct synchronization or gameplay audio.
Visible controllable gameplay and stable 30 FPS remain unverified.

interpretation: All selected pipelines in the initial 1404-entry driver-only warm were created, but a later title still rebuilt many.
Persistent-library probes created six, then loaded six with zero new creations. The expensive loads still took about 5-6 seconds each.
A library hit is not proof of avoiding driver compiler work or improving frame rate.
Only completed runs with finalized metadata are included; preparation is not gameplay.
The physical floor was removed at the user request. Commit and job limits remain independent.
Frame samples do not establish stable 30 FPS or visible, controllable gameplay.
PCM measurements do not establish audible speaker output or synchronization.
